faq.q1: How is this different from OpenClaw hosting at $9 a month?
faq.a1: There the agent sits on someone else's server and is usually exposed to the internet by default. Here it is on your server, behind closed ports, with a spending cap and backups. You pay once for the install, not monthly rent that doubles after the promo period: Hostinger $5.99 to $11.99, xCloud $9.99 to $19.99, and KiloClaw went from $9 to $55 and shut down.
faq.a2: Open-source personal agent frameworks. A program on your server you talk to in Telegram: it keeps context, works with files, mail and calendar, and learns your tasks. The model (Claude, GPT, Gemini and others) connects through OpenRouter. Need a different framework, say ZeroClaw or PicoClaw for small hosts: ask us.
faq.q3: I don't have a VPS. What now?
faq.a3: We point you to a provider for your country and budget, signup takes five minutes. The server is in your name, we are not a middleman.
faq.q4: Which providers and countries do you support?
faq.a4: Any VPS provider in any country: Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Vultr, Contabo and others. The only requirement is Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04 and SSH access for you.
faq.a5: Monitoring sends you a Telegram alert. 30-day install guarantee: if any check stops working for reasons other than your own changes, we fix it for free. After that under support or one-off.
faq.a6: The install is done by our automated pipeline and the result is checked by a human. That is why the price is fixed and the lead time is one day.
